title: Chat: per-message notification groupKey

requirements.expectation: POST /api/messages/send passes groupKey msg-{conversationId}-{message.id} into insertNotification so a second message in the same conversation is not skipped by dedupe.
requirements.verification: Unit test asserts insertNotification groupKey includes conversation id and message id; inspect send route.
evidence: vitest src/app/api/messages/__tests__/send.test.ts — 8 passed (2026-11-01), including per-message groupKey assertion for msg-2

requirements.expectation: Unused POST /api/messages/notify uses the same per-message key shape when a messageId is available (unique fallback otherwise) so it cannot reintroduce conversation-level skip.
insertNotification still skips when the same group_key already exists (payout / job-complete behavior preserved).
requirements.verification: Inspect src/lib/server/notifications.ts; no semantic change required for this fix.
evidence: src/lib/server/notifications.ts unchanged; skip-if-existing group_key still in place

requirements.expectation: With two authenticated clients on a live job chat, a second inbound message while the peer is not on the thread surfaces another in-app toast or center unread row.
requirements.verification: Manual two-device or two-browser smoke on a non-production host; record sanitized evidence.

code: Independent human review against the implementation commit; set reviewedCommit when recorded.
external: Authenticated live smoke: two subsequent messages → toast/center each time while peer is off-thread.

implementationState: Code + unit tests done; live smoke and formal review pending
